themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including their capabilities, limitations, and applications.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focusing on AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and optimizing code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles detailing specific AI platforms and software designed to facilitate and accelerate scientific and general research processes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Coverage of AI technologies and techniques used to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: This theme covers AI applications that directly aid in the design process and user research activities, including ideation, prototyping, and analysis.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Articles focused on using AI to analyze user feedback, reviews, and social media to gauge sentiment and extract insights.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Content discussing the creation and use of artificial user profiles or data for testing, training, or simulation purposes.

themes.name: AI workflow optimization
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI can streamline and improve operational processes and task management within research and development.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discussions on how AI is changing job roles, skill requirements, and the overall employment landscape.

themes.name: AI ethics in research
themes.description: Articles addressing the ethical considerations and best practices for applying AI in research contexts.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
